specification.head_grid_note: Legacy head image_size/patch_size fields set four positional tokens only; its patch embedder is deleted. The actual image encoder input is native 224 pixels.
specification.selection: Reuse the fixed pretrained branch recipe for all neural kernels. Best EMA checkpoint by class-balanced validation NLL. Linear regularization by the same validation criterion. No test-selected settings.
specification.execution: Native-224 official PneumoniaMNIST with frozen ImageNet ResNet-18, four spatial tokens, four-qubit quantum gate attention. Independent full-test PennyLane compute-uncompute verification for both quantum maps.
specification.disclosure: Exploratory separate resolution regime, sharing the previously inspected official cohort. External ImageNet pretraining. Higher-resolution inputs change the data regime; a gain over 28-pixel results cannot be attributed solely to quantum algorithms. All failed branches are preserved. No physical QPU or algorithmic novelty claim.
